appCards.title: Sliqe
appCards.desc: A hyper-local, two-sided marketplace designed to eliminate urban food waste through dynamic pricing. To solve the notorious friction of F&B tech adoption, the platform features a streamlined 30-second vendor inventory portal. On the consumer side, a time-decay algorithm systematically drops surplus food prices as closing time approaches, driving impulse conversions via location-based push notifications.
appCards.tags: Product Strategy, UI/UX Design, Two-Sided Marketplace, Dynamic Pricing, MVP, Figma

about.headline:
I build products.
Not just code.
about.p1: I'm a Computer Science student in Singapore building production-grade software as a way to learn by doing. Not demos — real apps with real users, real auth, and real architecture decisions.
about.p2: My edge: I move fast because I understand the full stack. I've shipped products from database schema to deployed UI, integrated AI APIs, and handled everything in between.
about.p3: Knot is my flagship project — a group expense and household management app built on Next.js, Supabase, and Vercel. It has Google OAuth, real-time data, and a Telegram bot companion.
about.p4: Why build in public? Accountability forces quality. And the documentation becomes the portfolio.
about.stack: TypeScript, Next.js, Python, Supabase, Vercel, Astro, Google Gemini API, Telegram Bot API
